purpose: Concept previews only; not implemented UI or measured timings

prompts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a high-fidelity landscape UI CONCEPT PROTOTYPE of a unified Unity UI motion design gallery, in the approved cream garden soft painted 3D toy style. Input images are ART STYLE REFERENCES only, not edit targets or layouts to copy. The user wants new extensible design capabilities, not reused old game screens. One coherent desktop application screen, 3-column layout: narrow left catalog of button, popup, transition, reward, loop, choreography items; broad center viewport; right inspector. Header title 动效设计, header tabs 自动播放 and 真实操作, no separate workshop or laboratory entries. Right inspector prominently shows a segmented control 克制 / 标准 / 庆祝, 标准 selected, then controls 回弹 / 位移 / 错峰, and clear mint 导出配置 button. Center viewport showcases THREE DISTINCT NEW blank-material buttons with native Chinese labels: mint cream capsule 开始, peach soft rounded rectangle 领取, lavender embossed circular star icon. Buttons have restrained thin gold/cream bevels and soft shadows, believable layered UGUI construction. Center footer contains three side-by-side enlarged sequential keyframe tiles of the SAME mint button, showing mild press, small overshoot, settled rest; labels 按下 / 回弹 / 稳定. Small clean strip caption 文字保持稳定 · 点击区域固定. The selected material and native text remain consistent across keyframes. Ivory and cream surfaces, mint/lavender/honey-gold/cocoa text palette, warm top-left light, ample spacing, precise readable Chinese typography. Polished actual product prototype rather than a presentation of code or excessive annotations. Rounded tactile controls, rich but restrained art. Avoid neon, dark dashboard, extra floating animals/flowers, dense paragraphs, illegible small text, duplicated nav panels, phone frames. Landscape 1536x1024 or similar, full composition visible.

Use case: ui-mockup / animation storyboard. Create ONE landscape high-fidelity concept board with FOUR equal large portrait mobile UI screens side by side showing sequential stages of a NEW achievement reward page for the same cream garden casual game style. Input images are style references only, not targets to reproduce. Use an original rounded leaf-and-star achievement medallion, cream/mint/lavender/honey-gold materials, softly painted 3D toy rendering and soft warm shadows. Do not reuse the kitten or existing game's home screen, use a calm pastel garden backdrop and a consistent simple wallet top-right across all frames. Header title 页面编排. Four phase labels across top: 0.00 s / 0.25 s / 0.65 s / 1.10 s. Stage 1 shows dimming garden backdrop with a small faint cream panel beginning to appear; stage 2 shows the panel at near full size with heading 旅程达成, main emblem entering gently with a tiny ghosted position trace; stage 3 shows panel settled, emblem clear, compact rewards 金币 +120 and 星星 +3 entering in a staggered sequence with a few gold coins on a curved path toward the wallet; stage 4 shows all content settled and interactive mint CTA 继续探索 plus a small lavender 查看收藏. Maintain IDENTICAL final layout positions, text and reward values across relevant stages; show real pose/opacity changes so it reads as a time progression. Native-looking Chinese type, clean hierarchy, controls at safe distances from edges. Thin small arrows between frames. Bottom minimal four-part rhythm strip 背景 / 面板 / 主视觉 / 奖励与操作 using mint and gold bars, no dense explanatory text or code. This is proposed animation direction, not a claim of actual implemented footage or real timing. Avoid excessive confetti, star clutter, ornate fantasy metal, duplicate app screens unrelated to stages, phone hardware or hands. Landscape 1536x1024 or similar.

Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE high-fidelity landscape concept board about responsive layout and stable interaction for a cream garden game UI skill. Use supplied images ONLY as soft toy style references, create a NEW consistent reward-selection panel. Main composition: THREE polished UI layout examples side by side on warm ivory background: narrow portrait viewport labelled 短屏, taller portrait labelled 长屏, wide tablet viewport labelled 横屏. Same cream rounded panel titled 选择奖励, with THREE distinct new selectable reward cards using simple original soft 3D star, sprout, and round gem symbols; same mint CTA 确认选择 and lavender 返回. Short-screen layout has compact header and vertically scrollable rewards with clear scroll affordance, tall screen has generous vertical spacing, landscape uses horizontal reward cards and a balanced bottom action row. No critical content or CTA clips offscreen. Discreet dashed safe-area guides show reserved top/bottom system regions, actual UI content stays within them. Bottom band shows a close-up of the SAME mint button in three states: rest, press squash, released small rebound, while one identical dashed fixed hit rectangle stays unchanged around all three; label 点击范围固定 · 内部视觉变形. Next to that show a tiny exploded layer diagram of button background, stable Chinese label, and icon, clearly separated with fine lines and short labels 底板 / 文字 / 图标. Cohesive cream, mint, lilac, honey-gold, cocoa colors, softly beveled tactile material, professional spacing, readable large Chinese text. Practical UGUI-feasible geometry. The board must show responsive composition decisions, not merely stretched copies. Do not add a new stand-alone laboratory or workshop page. Avoid real devices, hands, code, excessive arrows, neon colors, dense text, reused cat/home game art. Landscape 1536x1024 or similar.
